name: io.github.NicolasPrimeau/artel
title: Artel
description: A smart notepad for everything you figure out — one that learns. Write a note once; it comes back when it's relevant. A background archivist merges, connects and retires notes so the pad improves on its own. Your agents read and write the same pad. Self-hosted.

artel_host.description: Host of YOUR self-hosted Artel instance (e.g. artel.example.com). There is no public instance — Artel holds your fleet's memory, so you run it.

headers.description: Your agent_id on the Artel instance
